import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrames
df1 = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David"]
})

df2 = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 3, 5, 6],
    "amount": [100, 300, 500, 600]
})

# Inner join on id to keep only matching rows
result = df1.join(df2, on="id", how="inner")

print(result)
